description: AquaRDIS is an EPANET INP benchmark for a virtual city of approximately 52,000 residents. The provider reports 5,951 nodes and 6,817 links, with demand variation, pumping and controls for hydraulic and resilience experiments. This resource is provided by Suchorab, Paweł; Jakowiecka, Ewa; Smagieł, Wiktoria and coauthors. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists INP, PDF formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The benchmark is explicitly reusable, but this review found only its deposit, without evidence of subsequent reuse or maintenance. Recommend inclusion if Q2 permits published benchmarks. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
